description:
THREE IDENTITIES IN ONE PAINTING.
Keep Spell I, Spell II, and Spell III as distinct identities — each stays itself (subject, form, palette). They share one scene and interact. Not a triptych, not a 3-panel collage, not one mashed hybrid that erases any identity.
Studio author: Logan Sevin.

MANDATORY PRODUCT PALETTE (override all source colors): Apricot (#CAA979); Coffee (#987962); Silver (#C0B6AB); Ash (#9B9AA1). Paint with these hex pigments as dominant hues.

THE THREE IDENTITIES (keep each one recognizable):
SPELL I — black Terminal with Green text (#400034)
Apricot (#CAA979) Terminal with Coffee (#987962) text

SPELL II — Paper Shadow Black Terminal with Green T… (#400035)
Paper Shadow Apricot (#CCBCAB) Terminal Frame with Silver (#C0B6AB) Text on a Ash (#9B9AA1) Screen.

FUSION: one
